(AI Image) Dhanteras 2026 Date : Dhanteras will be observed on Friday, November 6, 2026, marking the beginning of the five-day Diwali festival. The festival falls on Kartik Krishna Trayodashi and is dedicated to Lord Dhanvantari, Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Kubera. Devotees worship for health, wealth and prosperity, while gold, silver and other auspicious purchases are an important part of the celebrations.
 A common question is whether Dhanteras falls on November 6 or November 7 in 2026. Although the Trayodashi Tithi continues into November 7, the main Dhanteras observance and evening Lakshmi-Kubera puja fall on November 6. Here is the complete guide to Dhanteras 2026 date, puja muhurat, gold-buying time, Trayodashi Tithi, Yamadeepdaan, puja vidhi and auspicious shopping traditions.
 Dhanteras 2026: Date and Timings at a Glance
 Dhanteras Date: Friday, November 6, 2026
 Trayodashi Tithi Begins: November 6, 10:30 AM
 Trayodashi Tithi Ends: November 7, 10:47 AM
 Dhanteras Puja Muhurat: 6:02 PM to 7:57 PM
 Pradosh Kaal: 5:32 PM to 8:09 PM
 Vrishabha Kaal: 6:02 PM to 7:57 PM
 Gold and Silver Buying: Check the applicable auspicious shopping muhurat for your city
 The timings above are based on the New Delhi Panchang. Local timings may vary.

 Dhanteras 2026 Kab Hai? 
 Dhanteras 2026 kab hai ? Dhanteras will be celebrated on Friday, November 6. The festival is observed during Trayodashi Tithi and marks the beginning of the traditional five-day Diwali celebrations.
 Live Events
 Why Is Dhanteras Celebrated? Significance and History 
Dhanteras is associated with wealth, health, prosperity and longevity. The festival is connected with the Samudra Manthan, or the churning of the cosmic ocean, during which Lord Dhanvantari is believed to have emerged carrying a pot of Amrit, the divine nectar of immortality.
 Lord Dhanvantari is regarded as the divine physician and the deity associated with Ayurveda. His appearance is celebrated as Dhanvantari Jayanti, which falls on Dhanteras.
 The festival is also dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, and Lord Kubera, the guardian of wealth.
 Significance of Lord Dhanvantari 
Lord Dhanvantari is worshipped for good health, healing and longevity. His association with Ayurveda makes Dhanteras an important occasion for prayers related to physical well-being.
 Why Is Dhanteras Auspicious for Buying Gold and Silver? 
Gold and silver are traditionally associated with wealth, abundance and good fortune. Purchasing these metals on Dhanteras is believed to invite prosperity into the household.
The tradition is also linked to the symbolism of Lord Dhanvantari's Amrit Kalash. Buying new utensils, jewellery and other household items has become a part of Dhanteras celebrations across India.

 Dhanteras 2026 Gold Buying Muhurat: When to Buy Gold and Silver?
Buying gold and silver on Dhanteras is considered an auspicious tradition associated with prosperity, abundance and good fortune. Many families purchase jewellery, coins, silver utensils and other precious-metal items during the festival.
The auspicious shopping period is determined using the Trayodashi Tithi and relevant Panchang timings. The gold-buying muhurat may differ from the evening Dhanteras puja muhurat.
For Dhanteras 2026, the festival will be observed on Friday, November 6. Buyers should check the city-specific auspicious shopping timings before planning their purchases.
Gold and silver purchases are traditional customs rather than religious requirements. Buyers should also compare prices, check hallmarking and consider making charges before purchasing jewellery.
 Dhanteras 2026 Preparations: What to Do Before the Puja?
Families traditionally prepare their homes and puja areas before Dhanteras evening. The following preparations can help organise the observance:
 Clean the home, particularly the entrance and puja area.
 Arrange the idols or pictures of Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Kubera and Lord Dhanvantari.
 Keep the diya, flowers, kumkum, rice and other puja samagri ready.
 Prepare fruits, sweets and customary offerings.
 Arrange any gold, silver or utensils purchased for the occasion.
 Check the local Panchang for the puja muhurat and Yamadeepdaan timings.
 The exact preparations and rituals may vary according to regional and family traditions.
 Dhanteras 2026 Puja Vidhi and Samagri List 
Dhanteras puja is generally performed in the evening during the auspicious muhurat. Devotees worship Lord Dhanvantari, Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Kubera for health, wealth and prosperity.
 Dhanteras Puja Samagri 
The commonly used puja items include:
 Idols or pictures of Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Kubera and Lord Dhanvantari
 Puja thali, diya, cotton wicks and ghee or oil
 Flowers and garlands
 Kumkum, turmeric, sandalwood paste and akshat
 Incense sticks and camphor
 Fruits, sweets and Panchamrit
 Kalash filled with water
 Betel leaves and betel nuts
 Coins, gold or silver items
 Rice or wheat for traditional offerings
 How to Perform Dhanteras Puja at Home 
 Step 1: Clean and decorate the home 
Clean the house, particularly the entrance and puja area. Decorate with flowers, rangoli and diyas.
 Step 2: Prepare the puja area 
Place the idols or pictures of the deities on a clean platform. Arrange the puja samagri and light a diya.
 Step 3: Worship Lord Dhanvantari 
Offer flowers, sandalwood paste and traditional offerings to Lord Dhanvantari while praying for good health and longevity.
 Step 4: Perform Lakshmi-Kubera puja 
Offer flowers, kumkum, rice and sweets to Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Kubera. Light incense sticks and chant their names or traditional mantras.
 Step 5: Worship newly purchased items 
Place gold, silver, jewellery or utensils near the puja area and offer prayers according to family traditions.
 Step 6: Perform aarti 
Conclude the puja with aarti and prayers for prosperity, peace and happiness.
 Dhanteras 2026 Shopping Guide: What to Buy for Good Luck and Prosperity?
Dhanteras is considered an auspicious occasion for purchasing new items. Gold, silver and utensils are among the most popular choices.
 Gold and Silver 
Gold jewellery, gold coins, silver coins and silver utensils are commonly purchased on Dhanteras.
These metals are traditionally associated with prosperity and abundance. Buyers may choose jewellery or smaller coins according to their budget.
 Utensils 
Brass, copper and stainless-steel utensils are popular Dhanteras purchases.
Some families traditionally fill newly purchased utensils with rice, wheat or water before bringing them into the house.
 Jewellery and Coins 
Gold and silver jewellery, rings, chains, bangles and coins are often purchased for personal use, family celebrations or traditional savings.
 Vehicles and Household Items 
Many families choose Dhanteras to purchase cars, motorcycles, electronics, appliances and other household essentials.
These purchases are part of modern festive traditions, although they are not religious requirements.
 Broom 
Buying a broom on Dhanteras is considered auspicious in several regional traditions. It is associated with cleanliness and the removal of negativity, symbolising the preparation of the home for prosperity.
 What Not to Buy on Dhanteras 2026? 
Some households traditionally avoid purchasing certain items on Dhanteras. These customs differ across regions and families and are not universal religious rules.
 Iron items: Some families avoid purchasing iron because of traditional associations with Shani Dev.
 Sharp objects: Knives, scissors and other sharp objects are avoided in certain traditions because they are associated with cutting or breaking.
 Empty utensils: Some households prefer not to bring an empty utensil into the house. They may fill it with water, rice or wheat before bringing it inside.
 Oil and other items: Certain regional customs discourage purchasing oil or specific household items on Dhanteras.
 Dhanteras 2026 Yamadeepdaan: Significance and Rituals 
Yamadeepdaan is an important ritual associated with Dhanteras.
The tradition involves lighting a diya in honour of Lord Yama, the deity associated with death and dharma. It is believed that offering a lamp to Lord Yama brings blessings for longevity and protection from untimely death.
 When to Perform Yamadeepdaan? 
Yamadeepdaan is traditionally performed during the evening Pradosh period on Dhanteras.
For New Delhi, Pradosh Kaal on November 6, 2026, is from 5:32 PM to 8:09 PM.
Some households light a diya near the main entrance or outside the home, while others follow specific family traditions regarding its placement and direction.
 Dhanteras 2026 Mantras 
Devotees chant mantras during Dhanteras puja to seek blessings for health, wealth and prosperity.
 Lord Dhanvantari Mantra 
 ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय धन्वंतरये अमृतकलश हस्ताय सर्वामय विनाशनाय त्रैलोक्यनाथाय श्री महाविष्णवे नमः। 
This mantra is associated with Lord Dhanvantari and prayers for health and healing.
 Goddess Lakshmi Mantra 
 ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः। 
Devotees chant this mantra while praying for prosperity, financial stability and happiness.
 Lord Kubera Mantra 
 ॐ यक्षाय कुबेराय वैश्रवणाय धनधान्याधिपतये धनधान्यसमृद्धिं मे देहि दापय स्वाहा। 
This mantra is associated with Lord Kubera and prayers for wealth and abundance.
 Dhanteras 2026: Diwali Festival Calendar 
Dhanteras marks the beginning of the traditional five-day Diwali festival.
 Festival Date in 2026 
 Dhanteras Friday, November 6 
 Naraka Chaturdashi / Choti Diwali Saturday, November 7 
 Diwali / Lakshmi Puja Sunday, November 8 
 Govardhan Puja Monday, November 9 
 Bhai Dooj Tuesday, November 10
